description: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers in a neural network, comparing three distinct measurements. The x-axis represents the "Layer" number, ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis represents the "Abs Mean," scaled linearly from 0 to just above 4. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts near 0, fluctuates slightly between 0 and 0.5, then rises steadily to approximately 2.5 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to nearly 4.5 at layer 22; an orange dotted line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains consistently near 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean of baseline," which stays very close to 0.04 across all layers.
